говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.

надоесть.gloss: to bore, to get on someone's nerves

meanings.note: the person who is fed up is in the dative: 'мне надоело' = I'm fed up
goes right before the word it negates

никак.gloss: in no way, not at all

meanings.note: никак не могу = I just can't

examples.trans: I have no money at all.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

meanings.note: работать официанткой = work as a waitress; masculine: официант

meanings.en: not to care a bit (мне/родителям плевать на + accusative)

examples.trans: My parents don't care about me.

short n: понятно = it's clear, got it

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

принимать.gloss: to receive, to see (visitors); to take

продумать.gloss: to think through, to plan out
